4. During pendency of the suit, the plaintiff having been dispossessed by the defendants from the suit property on 30-4-1986, filed an application for amendment of the plaint inserting prayer for recovery of possession and for mesneprofit. The prayer for amendment was allowed by the Court. The suit, after amendment, stood as a suit for declaration that the defendant kabala deeds are forged, fraudulent, collusive, void, inoperative and not binding upon the plaintiff and also for recovery of khas possession over the suit land and mesneprofit. 

 7. With the above findings, the trial Judge decreed the suit. The kabala deeds dated 8 August, 1977 in favour of the defendant Nos. 1-5 had been declared illegal, collusive, inoperative and fraudulent. Decree of recovery of Khas possession over the suit land had been also granted in favour of the plaintiff. The trial Judge rejected the relief of mesneprofit.
